description: AirGuardTM Wireless Solutions implement leading cryptographic technologies including: AES, 3DES, SHA-1, HMAC SHA-1, 802.1x/EAP-TLS, Diffie-Hellman, RSA, and HTTPS/TLS. The solutions are implemented in an innovative manner so that critical performance is not sacrificed in providing a rugged FIPS 140 -2 secure solution. Additionally, the AirGuard Solution features an RF Manager that allows the adjustment of WLAN RF output power level, providing close or broad coverage with high throughput.
